regime_context: China A-shares shows a narrow, one-narrative tape: Coal is the lone eligible and dominant theme with thin breadth (0.5) and mean-revert texture, while nothing else is trend-gate eligible. The detector's own backtest verdict says the absolute-trend gate did not hold on this market's history (mean-reverting tape whipsaws it), so the entire display read is experimental here and any lean must be low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Gold Miners (currently rank #2, ineligible) clears the trend gate AND narrows the margin to Coal below 0.02 — that observable pair (eligibility flip plus near-parity score) would be the condition to retire this watch, since it would be the first concrete sign of leadership rotation in an otherwise one-narrative tape.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only theme that is both trend-gate eligible and ranks #1 by a wide margin, and is the named rotation leader with one_narrative dominant — meaning leadership is concentrated, not dispersed. I lean with the prevailing narrative direction only because the trend gate (the one validated drawdown-control leg from other markets) still flags it as the single governing theme, and the tape has no challenger clearing eligibility. Absent a confirmed handoff, the default is to sit with the leader, not anticipate its end.
evidence: Coal ranks #1 with score 0.992 and is the only eligible theme above it (Gold Miners #2 is eligible=false)
Rotation leader is Coal; margin over challenger 0.057 is modest but breadth_of_rotation frac is only 0.09 (narrow, not dispersing)
one_narrative is true and heading weight 0.25 concentrates in Coal
crowded=false, so no cap/size-down flag fires on the leader
theses.dissent: Coal has hurst_tag 'mean-revert' and breadth only 0.5, and the detector's own gate_helps=false says the trend gate did not reduce drawdown on this market — a mean-reverting regime where chasing the lone leader has historically been whipsawed. The leader is not confirmed by cohort breadth.

falsifier.text: Coal ETF 515220 falls below CSI 300 by 5% before the 15-trading-day check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks rank #3 and are trend-gate eligible with strong durability (0.83) and full breadth (1.0), but crowding_z 1.83 triggers the crowded flag. Crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade, but combined with the detector's own admission that crowding carries no basket-forward edge and the one-narrative concentration in Coal, Banks is a crowded second-tier theme with no reason to lean into it over the lone eligible leader. Leaning avoid (not underweight, not short) on the crowded non-leader.
evidence: one_narrative=true, absorption 0.34 — market absorbing into a single story, not rotating into Banks
theses.dissent: Banks has the strongest durability (0.83) and full breadth of any theme, a classic trend-health sign, and crowding flags have no forward edge so they could equally mark continued accumulation rather than vulnerability.

falsifier.text: Banks ETF 512800 sustains a lead over CSI 300 of 3% or more for 5 consecutive days before the 15-trading-day check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
